subject: maths
question: A solid sphere made of wax of radius 12 cm is melted and cast into solid hemispheres of radius 4 cm each. Find the number of such solid hemispheres.
solution:
Given:

Radius of solid sphere = 12 cm

Radius of small solid hemisphere = 4 cm 

Formula Used:

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr3

Volume of Hemisphere = (2/3)πr3

Where, r = Radius of the sphere 

Calculation:

The volume of the small solid sphere with a radius of 12 cm = (4/3) × π × 123

The volume of the small solid sphere with a radius of 4 cm = (2/3) × π × 43

Number solid hemispheres. = (4/3) × π × 123/(2/3) × π × 43 = 2 × 27 = 54

∴ 54 of such hemispheres can be made.
